subject: a tall weathered stone lantern standing alone at the right-hand edge of the frame, its carved roof mossy and split, the paper panels in its head a hot saturated orange, by far the brightest and most colourful thing in the picture, small crude figures hacked from rough pitted granite crowded at its base with scratched crooked faces, feathers and small pale animal bones tied to its shaft with twine, wet ferns and cedar roots massed around it on that side only, the left and the middle of the picture empty black night going back into nothing
